meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 当用户问起任何 senpi 提示（Tip）的含义或用法时，Claude 会先检查该用户实际能看到哪些提示，再核对程序代码，用用户使用的语言解释背后的机制，而不是只复述提示文字。
howto.when: 当你说“give-me-tips”、询问某条 Tip 的含义、或想了解某个被提示的功能如何工作时触发。

say.text: 帮我讲讲刚才那条 Tip: 行具体是什么意思？
say.note: 它会先查实时提示列表再深入解释

say.text: “Fable 5 拒绝”的提示背后逻辑是怎样的？
say.note: 它会核对代码并讲解完整后备架构流程

say.text: 我目前能看到哪些提示？有哪些被隐藏了？
say.note: 它会检查你的设置和历史并列出可见项

howto.what_en: When the user asks about any senpi tip (e.g., a Tip: line), Claude first checks which tips this particular user can actually see, then verifies the real code, and explains the underlying mechanism in the user's language instead of just paraphrasing the tip text.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'give-me-tips', asks what a Tip: line means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see.

say_en.text: Explain what that Tip: line I just saw actually means.
say_en.note: He looks up the live tip list and checks your settings first.

say_en.text: What's the real mechanism behind the 'Fable 5 refused' tip?
say_en.note: He verifies the code and explains the full pipeline.

say_en.text: Which tips am I able to see right now, and which are hidden?
say_en.note: He checks your settings and tip history and lists them.
